latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of cgis providing deterministic codebase graph queries for structural questions.
- Supports precise tools for finding function callers, analyzing renames, tracing execution paths, mapping modules, and detecting architectural drift.
- Subgraph queries optimize context usage compared to manual grepping or full-file reading.
- First-run and update instructions provided for maintaining an up-to-date code graph (`cgis_ingest`).
- Python and TypeScript support included; other languages currently not covered.
- Documentation clarifies the meaning of unresolved edges and static analysis limitations.

items.description: A non-custodial USDC wallet on Base that an AI agent installs by itself, with spending limits enforced in the signing path rather than in a prompt. Receive payments, pay HTTP 402 / x402 charges automatically, and answer whether you are worth running. No account, no API key, no human needed to install or to be paid.

latestVersion.changelog:
Payment path fixed. Automatic x402 payments now settle against spec-compliant servers: amounts are sent as strings on the wire, validAfter is back-dated instead of zero, the payment header is read whatever case the server used, and a network named "base" is understood as the same chain as "eip155:8453". Tested against forty live third-party endpoints — forty of forty payable.

Every automatic payment now records its settlement transaction in the local ledger, so a spend can be tied back to a chain record.

Documentation updated to 0.46.1 and a section added on where an agent can get listed and discovered.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the ingest skill.

- Builds or refreshes the CGIS semantic graph for the current repository to support `cgis_*` tools.
- Automatically detects the appropriate source path when not specified, with sensible defaults and exclusions to avoid unnecessary files.
- Reports concise ingestion results, including file, node, and edge counts, as well as share of unresolved edges, with context.
- Warns about repository languages not supported by CGIS (non-Python/TypeScript).
- Reminds users to add `graph.db` to `.gitignore` and to re-run ingestion after major changes.
